$comment: What plugin/scripts/repo-guard.mjs lets into the repository. Adding an entry here is how something is allowed on purpose — see docs/Repository guard.md.
$layout: Every directory named here may hold only the entries listed; a new file or folder beside them fails until it is added. Directories not named here are not checked this way.
$allow: Globs (** crosses folders, * does not). large: files over maxBytes. images: where pictures and videos may live. junk: paths the junk rules would refuse. homePaths: files that may name a real home directory.
